# Episode

The whole player: the 470 × 835 frame, a canvas for scenes, the header, and the studio deck with word-by-word narration, a scrubber and step, play, expand and…

`SparkInternals.Episode` · Frame

## Use

```jsx
<SparkInternals.Episode segments={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SparkInternals.Episode" segments="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

### Segment

One segment of an episode: a scene drawn on the canvas, or a beat (a one-sentence pause in the expanded deck).

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | Scene name, shown uppercase in the deck and the scene title. Beats have none. |
| `dur` | `number` | Seconds. Scenes run 6.5–9, beats 2.5. |
| `text` * | `string` | Narration. Wrap code in backticks to make a code pill. |
| `beat` | `boolean` |  |
| `draw` | `(K: Kit, t: number, dur: number, name: string, n: number) => void` | Draws the scene at local time t (seconds), in the 470-wide canvas space. Beats show the previous scene's last frame. |
